caption: The drawing depicts two gray ceramic jugs with blue detailing, positioned side by side to show different perspectives. Both jugs are rendered in a matte gray color with shadowed and highlighted areas to suggest curvature and volume. Each jug has two small curved handles on opposite sides and a pronounced spout extending outward. The jug on the left shows the numbers "1790" painted in blue beneath decorative blue swirl patterns on the upper half of the vessel. The jug on the right displays more blue decorative patterns near the top, including swirls and a leaf-like motif beneath the spout. Both jugs have a flared rim and a slightly rounded base. The background is a uniform, light beige color with no additional objects or markings, emphasizing the two jugs as the focal point of the drawing.
title: Batter Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
